long_description.text: Just like Mamma’s cooking Anthony knows every good job is all about preparation. Tony’s your man when it comes to defending home base but he don’t mind playing out of position if his crew need him to crack heads and redefine the front line.

ru.original: Just like Mamma’s cooking Anthony knows every good job is all about preparation. Tony’s your man when it comes to defending home base but he don’t mind playing out of position if his crew need him to crack heads and redefine the front line.
ru.translation: Главное в работе — это подготовиться к ней. Это Tony узнал от мамы, которая прекрасно готовила. Именно Tony лучше всего подходит для обороны вашей базы, но он не против поработать и в другой должности, и, если надо, проломить пару черепов или укрепить линию фронта.

es.original: Just like Mamma’s cooking Anthony knows every good job is all about preparation. Tony’s your man when it comes to defending home base but he don’t mind playing out of position if his crew need him to crack heads and redefine the front line.
es.translation: Al igual que las recetas de su mamá, Tony sabe que todo trabajo requiere preparación detallada. Es por eso que se destaca en crear defensas y bases de avanzada, pero tampoco le molesta ayudar en el ataque si es necesario.

de.original: Just like Mamma’s cooking Anthony knows every good job is all about preparation. Tony’s your man when it comes to defending home base but he don’t mind playing out of position if his crew need him to crack heads and redefine the front line.
de.translation: Tony weiß, dass - genau wie beim Frikadellenrezept seiner Mutter - die Vorbereitung das A und O ist. Er ist genau der Richtige für die Verteidigung eurer Basis, hat aber auch nichts dagegen, seiner Crew mal dabei zu helfen, ein paar Blockköpfe aufzubrechen und die Frontlinie vorzurücken.

pt.original: Just like Mamma’s cooking Anthony knows every good job is all about preparation. Tony’s your man when it comes to defending home base but he don’t mind playing out of position if his crew need him to crack heads and redefine the front line.
pt.translation: Assim como a receita de almôndegas da mamma, Tony sabe que um trabalho bem feito precisa de preparo. Ele é ótimo na criação de defesas para a sua base, mas não se importa em mudar de posição se sua equipe precisa que ele saia quebrando crânios e redefinindo a linha de frente.

fr.original: Just like Mamma’s cooking Anthony knows every good job is all about preparation. Tony’s your man when it comes to defending home base but he don’t mind playing out of position if his crew need him to crack heads and redefine the front line.
fr.translation: Comme Maman disait toujours pour la cuisine, tout est dans la préparation, et Anthony le sait bien. Il en connaît un rayon côté défense de la base, et n'hésitera pas à monter à l'assaut si ses coéquipiers ont besoin de son aide pour repousser les ennemis ou redéfinir la ligne de front.

description.text: The hero is Shielded (50% damage taken) while building.

ru.original: The hero is Shielded (50% damage taken) while building.
ru.translation: При строительстве герой ЗАЩИЩЕН (получаемый урон снижается на 50%).

es.original: The hero is Shielded (50% damage taken) while building.
es.translation: Reduce 50% el daño recibido al construir.

de.original: The hero is Shielded (50% damage taken) while building.
de.translation: Der Held ist beim Bauen geschützt (erlittener Schaden liegt bei 50 %).

pt.original: The hero is Shielded (50% damage taken) while building.
pt.translation: Este herói está Protegido (redução de 50% em danos recebidos) enquanto constrói.

fr.original: The hero is Shielded (50% damage taken) while building.
fr.translation: Le héros bénéficie d'une protection (réduction de 50 % des dégâts subis) lorsqu'il construit.

description.text: Buffs build speed for Tony and nearby allies and buffs Lil' Buddy turrets around Tony with bonus damage.

ru.original: Buffs build speed for Tony and nearby allies and buffs Lil' Buddy turrets around Tony with bonus damage.
ru.translation: Tony и находящиеся рядом товарищи станут быстрее, а огневая мощь стоящих рядом турелей — заметно увеличится.

es.original: Buffs build speed for Tony and nearby allies and buffs Lil' Buddy turrets around Tony with bonus damage.
es.translation: Acelera la velocidad de construcción para Tony y sus aliados cercanos y aumenta la potencia de sus torretas.

de.original: Buffs build speed for Tony and nearby allies and buffs Lil' Buddy turrets around Tony with bonus damage.
de.translation: Buffs beschleunigen Tony und nahe Verbündete. Gefechtstürme um Tony herum teilen mehr Schaden aus.

pt.original: Buffs build speed for Tony and nearby allies and buffs Lil' Buddy turrets around Tony with bonus damage.
pt.translation: Aumenta a velocidade de construção de Tony e de aliados próximos e aprimora torres de tiro perto de Tony, causando danos adicionais.

fr.original: Buffs build speed for Tony and nearby allies and buffs Lil' Buddy turrets around Tony with bonus damage.
fr.translation: La vitesse de construction de Tony et de ses alliés à proximité est augmentée. Les dégâts des tourelles près de Tony sont augmentés.
